name: Leaky bucket
summary: A level that rises with each request and drains at a steady rate. The same algorithm as the token bucket, stated as smoothing rather than as a budget.

complexity.space: O(k) for k keys, three integers each

params.name: capacity
params.description: Maximum level, and so the largest burst that fits at once.

notes: At equal parameters this is the token bucket exactly, under the substitution tokens = capacity - level. A vector in each policy pins the equivalence and a cross-policy test checks it over a random trace. The default capacity is 1 rather than the domain's reference burst of 100, because a caller who wants a burst allowance is describing a token bucket.
